points.text: INDIA bloc held a mock '**public impeachment**' of CEC **Gyanesh Kumar** (six charges, **13.2 crore** voters allegedly hit by SIR); **193 MPs**' removal notices were rejected 7 months ago.
U.P. CEO **Navdeep Rinwa** froze all **ECINET** logins of ERO computer assistants after **Pilibhit** (**13,150** voters altered) and 13 'Vikas Yadav' entries in Azamgarh.
AAP's first Punjab list: **40** sitting MLAs; CM **Bhagwant Mann** from **Dhuri**. Punjab has **117** seats; AAP won **92** in 2022; term ends **16 Mar 2027**.
**RSS** centenary-year national meet at **Indore**: 408 functionaries; founded **1925, Nagpur**, by **K.B. Hedgewar**; chief **Mohan Bhagwat**.
CJI **Surya Kant** gave the **N.R. Madhava Menon** award to AG **R. Venkataramani**; Menon founded **NLSIU Bengaluru**.
Justice **Ujjal Bhuyan**: **scientific temper** is a Fundamental Duty under **Art. 51A(h)**.
Mangolpuri fire FIR used BNS **Section 287** (negligent conduct with fire), **125(a)**, **105** and **3(5)**.
**IT Amendment Rules, 2026**: takedown within **3 hours** (was 36) under **Rule 3(1)(d)**; AI content must be labelled.
**Section 69A** of the IT Act = blocking power; **Section 79** = safe harbour, lost under **79(3)(b)**. MeitY advisories of **8 and 10 Oct** (the second to **Meta**) preceded mass takedowns.
**Keralam at 70**: CM **V.D. Satheesan** opened the Festival of Keralam — **Priyadarshini** free transport for women, **Operation Toofan** (anti-drug), Mission Samudra.
**Chhattisgarh** day (CM **Vishnu Deo Sai**): **Mahtari Vandan Yojana** paid **₹20,708 crore** to **68 lakh** women; CM Helpline **1076**.
Centre released an extra **₹1.09 lakh crore** tax devolution; States get **41%** of divisible taxes in **14** instalments.
Windfall review: petrol export duty **nil**, diesel **₹11.5/litre**, ATF **₹11/litre**; cotton import-duty exemption extended to **31 Dec**.
**NTPC** Q2 profit **₹5,320 crore (+14.3%)**; plant load factor **73.53%**.
**IOCL**: LPG under-recovery **₹184 → ₹229** a cylinder (Sept to Oct); **Russia ~55%** of its H1 crude basket.
SEBI chief **Tuhin Kanta Pandey** is watching **Tata Sons** governance; listed group firms follow **LODR** (**Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements**) norms.
Bengaluru's **Pranos Fusion** built **PRAGYA**, a **small tokamak**, India's first private one; the larger **PRANIK** blueprint is due by **2027**; **$7.2 million** raised.
**MoRTH** amended the **Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989** (Rule 115) to allow **E100** and **E85** — only in **flex-fuel** vehicles.
India hit **E20** blending in **2025**, five years before the **2030** target of the **National Policy on Biofuels, 2018**; all petrol is E20 from **April 2026**.
**UCADA** made a **co-pilot** mandatory on Uttarakhand pilgrimage helicopter routes.
**Bharat Renewable Energy Summit**, 2-5 Nov, **Bharat Mandapam**: 130+ countries.
Delhi's winter plan from **1 Nov**: C&D ban, no non-Delhi **below-BS-VI** vehicles, **50% work from home** till **31 Jan**; parking charges doubled till **28 Feb**.
**CPCB** ordered NCR units without **air pollution control devices** shut; CAQM's limit is **50 mg/Nm3** for **17** industry types; only **200 of 2,321** had complied.
APCD types: **bag filters**, **electrostatic precipitators**, **cyclone separators**, **scrubbers**.
**Mekedatu** reservoir (Cauvery, **Kanakapura**): **2,500 acres** identified, **66 tmc**, **400 MW**; Tamil Nadu opposes it.
India is **36%** urban; infant mortality is ~**8 per 1,000** in Kerala, Goa and Puducherry against ~**30** in U.P. and Rajasthan; green space sits under **AMRUT**.
*The Ghost of the Mountains* (**Kulbhushansingh Suryawanshi**): the **IUCN** moved the **snow leopard** from Endangered to **Vulnerable** in **2017**.
A low-pressure area over the **South Andaman Sea** was set to become a cyclone over the **Bay of Bengal**.
**Ferdinand Magellan** named the **Pacific** ('Mar Pacifico'); the **International Date Line** runs between the **Diomede** islands.

**Quad** FMs (Rubio, **Jaishankar**, **Motegi**, **Penny Wong**) met at **Atlanta** on the sidelines of the **G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting**: **$85 million** for trusted AI and **$10 million** for critical-minerals recycling.
Bhutan's **Project 108**: **108 chortens**, 15 m tall and 108 m apart along the **Mau Chhu** at **Gelephu**, built on 1 Nov; King **Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuk**.
Bangladesh's **Nahid Islam** opposed an Indian **transit corridor**; the **Ganges (Farakka) Treaty** of **12 Dec 1996** expires in December.
**Lula da Silva** won Brazil's runoff — the first to finish **second** in round one and still win; his **fourth** term; born in **Pernambuco**, he founded the **Workers' Party** on **10 Feb 1980**.
Israel's 27 Oct poll: turnout **77.7%**, the highest since 1999; Arab parties (**Joint List + Ra'am**) won **19** seats, their best ever.
**Serbia**: the student movement born of the **Novi Sad** canopy collapse won **141 of 250** seats, ending **Vucic's SNS** 14-year rule.
UK PM **Andy Burnham** is open to a **slavery apology** but not reparations; Britain abolished the trade in **1807** and slavery in **1833**, paying owners **£20 million**.
About **2 million** Indians went abroad as **indentured labour (1838-1917)**; **Barbados** became a republic in **2021**.
**CHOGM 2026** is in **Antigua and Barbuda**; **King Charles III** heads the **56-member** Commonwealth.
Iran's Supreme Leader **Mojtaba Khamenei** warned of a 'geographically unrestricted' response; IRGC chief **Ahmad Vahidi**.
**Poland**: President **Nawrocki** accused PM **Tusk** of a 'forced takeover' of the Constitutional Tribunal.
The US cleared the sale of **500 Patriot** missiles to **Ukraine**.
ACM **Ashutosh Dixit** took over as the **29th Chief of the Air Staff** on **31 Oct**, after **A.P. Singh**; **3,500+** flying hours.
**PANJ Foundation**: Punjab's cannabis use is **12.55%** — **4.4 times** the national rate and the highest of 36 States/UTs; opioids 4.7x.
Punjab's **Yudh Nashian Virudh** reached day **606**, with **88,979** arrests; DGP **Gaurav Yadav**.
ED's **Operation Trident**: **38** raids in Assam, Mizoram and Manipur, **18** arrests, **₹100 crore** of hawala.
Manipur: **COCOMI** rallied against the **SoO** pact (expired **4 Sept**); only **1 of 159** cadres was present in an audited camp.
At **Ekta Nagar**, Modi claimed India is **Naxal-free**, warned of '**dimagi Naxals**' and backed a '**secular civil code**'.
Kerala's Crime Branch booked **Kerala PSC** chair **M.R. Baiju**; State PSCs are constitutional bodies under **Art. 315**.
ISRO chief **V. Narayanan**: **NVS-03** flew with **three pyro valves open**; **NavIC** is back to its minimum of **four** satellites; NVS-04 is due in 5 months.
**NavIC** covers India plus **1,500 km**; NVS satellites carry **indigenous rubidium atomic clocks**, replacing Swiss **SpectraTime** ones.
**Five** IRNSS satellites are defunct; **NVS-01** (May 2023) was the first second-generation one; two **PSLV** failures paused 2026 launches.
**Alfred Wegener** (born 1 Nov 1880) proposed **continental drift**; **Eratosthenes** first measured Earth's circumference.
**NIPGR** found the calcium channel **CNGC13** carries a plant's alarm signal between leaves (*PNAS*); pests cost **20%** of global crops.
Gene therapy **CRMA-1001** silenced **hepatitis B** DNA by methylation using **CRISPR-Cas9** — a 'functional cure' in mice.
Fake references in science papers rose from **6 to 23 per 10,000** (2023-26), mostly from unchecked **AI tools**.
**Rub' al Khali**: 55 extinct lakes but no stone tools — early migration needed water **and** tool-stone; **Manx shearwaters** get jet-lagged.
**IRDAI** data: health insurers rejected about **₹30,000 crore** of claims in 2024-25 despite 96-98% settlement ratios.
Musk plans to merge **SpaceX and Tesla** (about **$3.5 trillion**); he could hold **37%** of equity but **56%** of the votes.
An Open Page essay cited **Dario Amodei**'s September call to pause AI development.
Profile: **Hechin Haokip**'s Centre for Women and Girls works on peace-building in Manipur's Kuki hill districts.
**31 Oct 2026** was the **42nd death anniversary** of **Indira Gandhi**; her memorial is **Shakti Sthal**.
**1 Nov** is foundation day for **Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh** (1956), **Haryana and Punjab** (1966) and **Chhattisgarh** (2000).
**Haryana at 60** (Hirak Jayanti; formed **1966**): President **Droupadi Murmu** was chief guest at Kurukshetra University; CM **Nayab Singh Saini**.
**490** personnel received the **Kendriya Grihmantri Dakshata Padak**, instituted on **1 Feb 2024**.
Painter **Jogen Chowdhury** (Padma Bhushan, ex-Rajya Sabha MP) died at **87**; filmmaker **Sanjay Gupta** died at **59**.
Who's who: Kerala CM **V.D. Satheesan**; Karnataka CM **D.K. Shivakumar**; ISRO **V. Narayanan**; SEBI **Tuhin Kanta Pandey**; AG **R. Venkataramani**.
World: UK **Andy Burnham**; Iran **Mojtaba Khamenei**; Poland **Karol Nawrocki** and **Donald Tusk**; Barbados **Mia Mottley**; Bhutan King **Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuk**.
Kashmir's **cockscomb flower** is dried into **mawal**, the red colour in **wazwan** dishes such as **rogan josh**; its chefs are **wazas**.
**Ramayana** (Namit Malhotra), India's most expensive film, stars **Ranbir Kapoor** and **Yash**; it releases on **5 Nov**.
**Kagiso Rabada** became the **fastest to 350 Test wickets** by balls (**13,808**).
**Simon Harmer**'s **6/16** bowled Australia out for **111** at **Newlands**; **South Africa** won 2-1 and topped the **ICC Test rankings**.
**West Indies** beat Bangladesh at Mirpur; **Pakistan** won the Lahore tri-series final (**Fakhar Zaman 127**).
**Manisha Bhanwala** (Jind) joined **Sushil Kumar (2010)** as an Indian wrestling world champion, winning **59kg** 8-6.
Men's **Asian Champions Trophy** (from **2011**): India is ranked **8th**, Asia's only top-10 team; coach **Craig Fulton**.
**Kolkata** hosts an **AFC Women's Champions League** group with **East Bengal**.
Third **WTA 250 Chennai Open**: wild cards **Vaishnavi Adkar**, **Maaya Rajeshwaran** and Sahaja Yamalapalli; defending champion **Janice Tjen**.
Teen paddler **Swara Karmarkar** (**Nashik**, world No. 947) reached the **WTT Feeder Chennai** semis.
